claims.text: The resort is on the east end of St. Thomas, with views of Great Bay and access to the neighboring islands of St. John and the British Virgin Islands.

findings.quote: idyllic east end, our resort offers breathtaking views of Great Bay and seamless access to the neighboring islands of St. John and the British Virgin Islands.

claims.text: The resort is a 30-acre oceanfront property.

findings.quote: A breathtaking 30-acre, oceanfront luxury resort

claims.text: The resort has a free-form infinity edge pool and a Family Pool with a waterslide.

findings.quote: Enjoy our 125-foot free-form infinity edge pool or make a splash at the Family Pool and waterslide

claims.text: Alloro Restaurant serves a Sicilian-inspired menu with fresh pasta, seafood and hearty mains.

findings.quote: Savor the flavors of Sicily with a menu inspired by its rich culinary traditions. Enjoy fresh pasta, vibrant seafood and hearty mains

claims.text: Sails Beachside Restaurant & Bar is an oceanfront restaurant by day and becomes an open-air bar at night, serving grilled steaks and seafood.

findings.quote: By day, Sails is an oceanfront retreat in St. Thomas where relaxed elegance meets the rhythm of island life. As night falls, it transforms into an open-air bar, offering grilled steaks and signature seafood dishes

claims.text: Coconut Cove Restaurant is a beachfront restaurant with an American twist, serving bites by day and grilled dishes at night.

findings.quote: This is a relaxed beachfront retreat with an American twist, serving up zesty bites by day and grilled favorites with coastal flair by night.

claims.text: The Three-Bedroom Presidential Suite has five full bathrooms, private ocean-view terraces, and living and dining areas.

findings.quote: featuring five full bathrooms, private ocean-view terraces, and spacious living and dining areas

claims.text: The Club Lounge offers four food and beverage presentations each day: breakfast, a light lunch, heavy hors d'oeuvres at dinner and a dessert buffet at night.

findings.quote: daily array of four food and beverage experiences
Start your day with made-to-order omelets and breakfast staples
For a light lunch, savor refreshing options
In the evening, unwind with a spread of heavy hors d’oeuvres, and end on a sweet note with our enticing dessert buffet.

claims.text: The resort has two lighted omni-synthetic tennis courts.

findings.quote: two omni-synthetic tennis courts, lighted for nighttime playing

claims.text: The resort runs a Ritz Kids program for children.

findings.quote: an immersive and adventurous Ritz Kids program

claims.text: The watersports team assists guests with Hobie Cats, kayaks, snorkel equipment and stand-up paddleboards.

findings.quote: Our Watersports team is dedicated to assisting guests with Hobie Cats, kayaks, snorkel equipment, and stand-up paddleboards.

claims.text: The resort has its own sailing catamaran, the Lady Lynsey II, used for sunset sails, day sails to the British Virgin Islands, snorkeling tours and private events.

findings.quote: exclusive luxury sailing catamaran, The Lady Lynsey II. Embark on a sunset sail through the bay, a day sail to the British Virgin Islands, snorkeling tours and private events.

claims.text: St. John is a short three miles across Pillsbury Sound, and the British Virgin Islands are a short boat ride away.

findings.quote: St. John is a short three miles across Pillsbury Sound and the British Virgin Islands are just a short boat ride away.

claims.text: Club Level stays include access to a private Club beach.

findings.quote: Enjoy the tranquility of our private Club beach offering unparalleled relaxation and stunning views.
findings.note: Private Club beach on the Club page

findings.quote: a dedicated concierge, a private beach and indoor and outdoor lounges with ocean views

claims.text: The spa offers a Seaside Cabana Massage at the water's edge that can be shared as a couples massage.

findings.quote: relax and unwind at the water’s edge. Can also be shared with someone special as a couples massage.

claims.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.

findings.quote: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

claims.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.

findings.quote: *Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.

claims.text: A daily resort fee applies, covering fitness classes, non-motorized watersports, snorkel gear, Wi-Fi and tennis court use.

findings.quote: Our daily resort fee of $95 grants access to a thoughtfully curated collection of amenities, including daily fitness classes
introductory and daily use of non-motorized watersports, snorkel gear with guided instructions to the nearby reef, enhanced Wi-Fi access, tennis court use with rackets and balls
